deploy-bot: Rollout: v1.16.7 -> prod-usw2 (canary 7%). Rollout ID rl_h5k2. Runbook: ops.redwood/runbooks/postdeploy-smoke.

maya: Heads-up — embeds-route synth showed a short-lived error burst: ~30s of 502s at 11:03 UTC on requests >1024 tokens. Overall error-rate ~0.6% during window, p95 also rose.

eric: Oof. Is this the new quantized variant?

model-ops: Yes, embeds-v2q deployed in this rollout. Could be a memory regression on large inputs causing worker OOMs that return 502.

maya: Quick smoke with large payload now:
```bash
PAYLOAD=$(python -c "print('x'*1500)")
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/embeds-route/smoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d "{\"text\": \"$PAYLOAD\"}" -w "TIME:%{time_total}s STATUS:%{http_code}" -o /dev/null
```

maya: Pre-mitigation smoke: TIME:1.92s STATUS:502

ops: Options: 1) immediate rollback of embeds-route variant (blunt), 2) apply conditional fallback for large payloads to previous model for 30m, 3) scale worker pool temporarily and run warmup. Prefer targeted fallback to avoid full rollback.

eric: I can add a route-rule to route tokens>1024 to embeds-v1.21 for 30m. That should stop user-facing 502s while we triage.

model-ops: Meanwhile I'll check worker logs and OOM traces. If it's memory growth in v2q, we need a hotfix.

ops: Please run the rule command when ready.

eric: Running:
```bash
redwoodctl route rule add --route embeds-route --match "tokens>1024" --model redwood-embeds-v1.21 --duration 30m --reason "postdeploy 502s on large payloads"
```

deploy-bot: Action: route rule applied -> embeds-route tokens>1024 -> redwood-embeds-v1.21 for 30m by eric. Audit=aud_5b8f.

maya: Rerun smoke after rule:
```bash
PAYLOAD=$(python -c "print('x'*1500)")
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/embeds-route/smoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d "{\"text\": \"$PAYLOAD\"}" -w "TIME:%{time_total}s STATUS:%{http_code}" -o /dev/null
```

maya: Post-rule smoke: TIME:0.56s STATUS:200. No errors in that sample.

model-ops: Logs show worker process for v2q hitting memory high-water on large inputs and restarting once. Trace attached: https://traces.redwood/rl_h5k2/trace_91. Root cause likely a quant kernel regression for long sequences.

ops: Plan: keep fallback rule 30m, run targeted warmup and a memory stress test, decide: if warmup stabilizes (no restarts for 10m) reintroduce at 1% and monitor 15m; otherwise prepare v2q rollback and mark as regression in release notes.

sre-oncall: Pager policy: suppress noisy p95 alerts for this rollout window; escalate on 5xx>0.5% (we already hit threshold once). If another sustained >0.5% occurs, open rollback.

maria: (note) I'll add release artifact entry: "embeds-route tokens>1024 routed to v1.21 for 30m due to worker memory restarts in v2q; trace link attached." artifacts.redwood/rl_h5k2/embeds-prefill-note.txt

model-ops: Starting warmup and stress test now. Will report results in ~8m.

maya: Closing this thread if stable after 25m.
